metaTitle: COSMIC Overview Swipe — touchpad swipes in the workspace overview
metaDescription: Swipe between workspaces inside the COSMIC workspace overview on Pop!_OS, with the strip following your fingers like macOS Mission Control. Prebuilt, no sudo, easy to remove.
heroLede: On Pop!_OS a 3- or 4-finger touchpad swipe switches workspaces, but does nothing while the workspace overview (Super+W) is open. This patch makes the overview follow your fingers, like Mission Control on macOS: the workspaces slide with you and land on the one you aim for. It installs without sudo and leaves your system packages alone.
demoCaption: The overview open with Super+W: a swipe slides the workspaces under the fingers and settles on the next one.
featuresSub: Only the workspace overview. Outside it, COSMIC keeps handling the swipe exactly as before.
f1n: Pause and it pauses; go back and it goes back. Fast and slow swipes cover the same distance per workspace.
f2n: A flick moves on to the next workspace, a slow drag settles on the nearest one, and a long fast swipe can skip several.
f3n: Swipe along the axis COSMIC lays your workspaces out on, in the same direction as its own swipe.
f4n: Past the last workspace comes the first one when COSMIC wraps around; otherwise it stops with a little bounce.
f5n: Two-finger swipes on an Apple Magic Mouse work inside the overview as well, through MouseTouch.
f6n: Nothing in /usr changes. After a system update with no matching build, COSMIC simply starts its own overview again.
installSub: For Pop!_OS 24.04 with COSMIC, x86_64 or ARM. The patched overview has to match your exact COSMIC version, so the installer picks the build for the version you have, checks it and refuses if there is none.
statusLatest: Supported (latest COSMIC at the time of writing)
checkNote: The last part of the version, after the final ~, is the revision. If yours is not listed, the installer stops without changing anything; see Help.
run1: Downloads the build for your revision from the latest release and verifies its SHA-256 checksum.
run2: Puts it in ~/.local/opt/overview-swipe/ and adds a small wrapper at ~/.local/bin/cosmic-workspaces, which COSMIC starts instead of the system overview.
run3: Restarts the overview. If it says your session does not look in ~/.local/bin yet, log out and back in once.
useSub: Press Super+W (or click Workspaces in the panel), then swipe with 3 or 4 fingers on the touchpad.
updateSub: When Pop!_OS updates COSMIC to a new revision, the wrapper notices and starts the stock overview, so nothing breaks; the swipe is just off. Run the install line again: it fetches the build for the new revision as soon as there is one.
removeSub: Deletes the wrapper and the downloaded build and restarts the stock overview. Your settings file is kept.
srcSub: Prefer to compile? The repository has the patch series per revision and a script that clones upstream at your revision, applies them and builds (needs Rust and a few -dev packages, about ten minutes).
settingsSub: Optional. The installer creates ~/.config/cosmic-overview-swipe.env with the settings commented out. Edit it, then restart the overview:
settingsNote: The swipe direction follows COSMIC's natural scrolling setting for the touchpad, the same as its swipe outside the overview.
howSub: While the overview is open, COSMIC's compositor stops switching workspaces itself and hands the touchpad swipe to the overview, which until now did not listen. The patch adds that part to cosmic-workspaces, the program that draws the overview.
h1n: The overview subscribes to touchpad swipe gestures from the compositor.
h2n: Pointer acceleration is undone, so the distance per workspace does not depend on how fast you swipe.
h3n: The windows of the neighbouring workspaces are captured ahead of time, so they slide in fully drawn.
h4n: A spring animation carries the release velocity to the target, then the overview asks COSMIC to switch to it.
statusNote: Why is this not in COSMIC? It is not submitted to System76 for now, so it is distributed here: prebuilt for the exact COSMIC versions it was tested on, with the source and patches in the repository. The series also fixes an overview crash with windows on several workspaces.
c1: Your COSMIC revision is newer or older than the releases. Nothing was changed. Watch the releases, or open an issue with the output of dpkg-query -W cosmic-workspaces.
s2: Swiping in the overview does nothing
c2: Run status. "Build for this revision: no" means COSMIC was updated: run the install line again. If the stock overview is running, log out and back in once.
c3: Set COSMIC_WORKSPACES_SWIPE_MM (default 20; 30–40 feels calmer on some touchpads) and run restart.
c4: It follows the touchpad natural scrolling setting in COSMIC Settings, like COSMIC's own swipe.
c5: Install MouseTouch 0.1.13 or newer, which follows COSMIC's horizontal or vertical layout.
s6: I want the stock overview back
c6: Run uninstall. Nothing else on the system was touched.
helpMore: Details, the patch series and test notes are in the repository. Questions or another COSMIC version: issues.
